# teams_online_dial_in_conferencing_tenant_settings (Resource)

Manages the OnlineDialInConferencingTenantSettings configuration via Set-CsOnlineDialInConferencingTenantSettings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `allow_federated_users_to_dial_out_to_self` (String) Maps to the -AllowFederatedUsersToDialOutToSelf parameter.

- `allow_pstn_only_meetings_by_default` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowPSTNOnlyMeetingsByDefault parameter.

- `send_email_from_override` (Boolean) Maps to the -SendEmailFromOverride parameter.
- `use_unique_conference_ids` (Boolean) Maps to the -UseUniqueConferenceIds parameter.
